EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No. : MCUDP/LA/MUT (W-14)/14/02/A.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire and own the following blocks of land for the construction of a tunnel drainage line from the main canal in Aluth Mawatha area up to the sea which is a sub project undertaken under Metro Colombo Urban Development Project.
Description of the land to be acquired:

The undermentioned allotments of lands situated in Aluth Mawatha Village belonging to Aluth Mawatha Grama Niladhari Division in the District of Colombo, Western Province made by the Surveyor General on 07.10.2016 and depicted as Lots No. 62,63,65,69,70 - 158 in the Preliminary plan No. ෙකʣ. 9654 containing in Extent 0.3437 Hectare.
